title: Covariance from nonconstant Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $\pi$, and let $\{\phi_a:a\in\iota\}$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real functions on $\Omega$ in the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with a constant-one basis vector indexed by $0$. For any nonnegative integer $n$ and functions $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, their covariance under the product measure $\pi^n$ equals $\sum_{a\ne(0,\ldots,0)}\widehat f(a)\widehat g(a)$, where the hats denote product Fourier coefficients.
hypotheses_covered: probability measure on the sample space
orthonormal real-function basis with a constant-one basis vector
functions f and g on the product space
